summary_en: Cross Plus executed a block purchase of 234,300 shares (3.1% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) at 1,299 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on September 25, 2026. The transaction was conducted as a single order at the opening of the exchange on that date.
title_en: Notice Regarding Self-Issued Share Purchase via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On September 25, 2026, Cross Plus conducted a block purchase of 234,300 shares of its own common stock via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3) at the closing price of 1,299 yen per share. The transaction was executed as a single order during the opening session of the Tokyo Stock Exchange at 8:45 a.m. This purchase was implemented as part of a broader share buyback program authorized by the Board of Directors on September 4, 2026, which permitted the acquisition of up to 250,000 shares (3.35% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for an aggregate maximum of 350 million yen during the period from September 7 through November 30, 2026. The 234,300 shares purchased represent approximately 3.1% of the company's issued share capital excluding treasury stock, calculated as 234,300 divided by 7,548,189 shares (the denominator from the reference section). As of September 24, 2026, prior to this transaction, the company had completed no purchases and spent no funds under the authorization.
